{{Quote|Rogue Leader, this is Rescue 3. We're in position. Evacuating prisoners now.|''Rescue 3'' to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
'''''Rescue 3''''' was the callsign of a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
During the Alliance [[raid at Bakura]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[raid at Bakura]] follows the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> ''Rescue 3'', alongside [[Rescue 1 (GR-75 medium transport)|''Rescue 1'']] and [[Rescue 2 (GR-75 medium transport)|''Rescue 2'']], evacuated freed [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from fleeing [[Imperial Action transport|Imperial Action transports]] under the protection of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'' {{1st}}
